revisionDesc.change: Commit - Entered BL corrections, but the one to lin28 required adjustment. || lin3 Ἀρσινοείτου => Ἀρσινοίτου; lin8 ἓβδομον => ἕβδομον

Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - [ἐπικεχωρη]κ̣έ̣ν̣α̣ι̣ is superior to [μεμισθω]κ̣έ̣ν̣α̣ι̣ and should be recorded as a PN correction. || lin1 Οὐεσ(πασι)άνου => Οὐεσ(πασι)ανοῦ (but there is no abbreviation) & lin9 [Οὐεσπασι]άνου => [Οὐεσπασι]ανοῦ || Add corrections from BL IX 111.

Commit - I added an alternate reading to l. 7[μεμισθω]κ̣έ̣ν̣α̣ι̣ in the app. or or [ἐπικεχωρη]κ̣έ̣ν̣α̣ι̣. This is a typical ἐπιχώρησις-deed ( public, registered, in the form of ὁμολογεῖ ὁ ... τῶι ..., and most importantly the land to be leased is a public not a private land). Further more we don't know how much is missing at the left side. So I suppose that in l. 7 the form of the verb to be restored would be [ἐπικεχωρη]κ̣έ̣ν̣α̣ι̣ since this is the usual form in this kind of deeds. For more details s. Hans-Albert Rupprecht, "Rechtsübertragung in den Papyri. Zur Entwicklung von Parachoresis und Ekchoresis." in Gedächtnisschrift für Wolfgang Kunkel (Frankfurt am Main, 1984) pp. 365-390., 365-390
